summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for token usage extraction and attribution in LLM instrumentation spans. It differs semantically from peer candidates (streaming instrumentation, span management, function decoration) and existing skills (observation convention, image optimization). No existing skill captures the specific capability of extracting token metrics from LLM responses and recording them as span attributes. Peer candidates address related but separate instrumentation concerns (streaming wrappers, generic span creation, function decoration). The candidate has support evidence and no conflicts.
